text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we split 'render orchestration' out of the query service.

alex: Motivation: RBAC checks need richer context (user/org/route) and we're currently forcing query layer to perform authz and widget filtering, which multiplies fanout and increases tail latency.

alex: High-level: make a thin orchestrator that does authz + routing, then fans out minimal queries to query-exec and streams to renderers.

chloe: Are you suggesting a separate service that centralizes authz and stitching?

alex: Yes. Sketch:
- orchestrator receives UI route + token
- does authz once and resolves allowed widgets/variants
- issues compact query requests to query-exec (only fields needed)
- streams responses to renderer pool for layout composition

sam: Sounds promising for tail latency, but extra hop can increase cost and complexity. Any cost mitigation ideas?

alex: We add authz caching per-session, prefix/KV caching to avoid repeated query-exec hits, and small batching windows to coalesce near-simultaneous widget requests. Should net lower token work downstream.

nina: Compatibility question — dashboards rely on query-exec for pagination cursors and incremental updates. How do we keep cursor semantics correct?

alex: Two options:
1) Orchestrator stitches cursors returned by query-exec into a composite cursor (recommended), so UI sees same semantics.
2) Expose a cursor-translation shim in front of UI (bigger surface area).

chloe: Can you share a minimal rollout/config sketch?

alex: Sure: 
```
render.orch.enabled: true
render.orch.auth_cache_ttl: 30s
render.orch.batch_window_ms: 10
render.orch.fallback_to_exec: true
```

sam: What's the concrete RBAC win here?

alex: Single place for policy evaluation -> deterministic allow lists per-route, simpler audit trail, less duplicated policy checks across N widgets. Easier to add route-level ABAC rules without changing query-exec.

nina: Telemetry note: we need 95/99/999 latencies per hop and request-level traces that cross orchestrator->exec->renderer. Also measure cost per-request changes.

infra-bot: perf jobs: queued dashboard-latency/prototype-run (branch: feat/render-orch) — will run nightly.

chloe: Migration plan idea: opt-in per-tenant feature flag for 2 weeks, collect KPIs, then widen. Need an emergency rollback/auto-fallback.

alex: Agreed — fallback_to_exec will enable automatic pass-through if orchestrator errors or circuit opens. We'll also add a hard circuit-breaker with enforced timeout and metric alerts.

alex: Action items:
- alex: prototype orchestrator stub + basic auth cache (1w)
- nina: design cursor-stitching interface + test vectors (3d)
- sam: run cost model on additional hop + caching savings (2d)
- chloe: add rollout flags + KPI dashboard (2d)

sam: +1 on timeline. Also suggest a small canary: 5% of dashboards in eu-west first.

chloe: ok — sync Wed 10am to review prototype and perf outputs. :thumbsup:
